en.t: If you do not believe me, please touch my sleeve.

units.source_text: 众侍女异口同声地叫道：“确是‘色妍香更浓’啊！”

en.t: The waiting women cried out in one voice, "It really is 'the more beautiful the color, the richer the fragrance'!"

units.source_text: 大家喧哗起来，几乎想拉他的衣袖。

en.t: Everyone burst into noisy excitement and almost wanted to tug at his sleeve.

units.source_text: 玉鬘尚侍从里面膝行而出，低声说道：“你们这些人真讨厌，连这个温顺的老实人也不放过，不怕难为情。”

en.t: Tamakazura, the Naishi no Kami, came shuffling out on her knees from within and said softly, "You people are truly tiresome. You will not even leave this gentle, honest man alone. Aren't you ashamed?"

units.source_text: 薰君听见了，想道：“被称为老实人，我好委屈啊！”

en.t: Kaoru heard this and thought, "How unfair it is to be called an honest man!"

units.source_text: 尚侍的幼子藤侍从还不曾上殿任职，不须到各处贺年，此时正在家中。

en.t: The Naishi no Kami's young son, Fuji no Jiju, had not yet entered service at court, so he did not need to go around making New Year's calls and was at home at the time.

units.source_text: 他捧出两个嫩沉香木制的盘子，内盛果物和杯子等，拿来招待薰君。

en.t: He brought out two trays made of fresh aloeswood, filled with fruit, cups, and other things, and offered them to Kaoru.

units.source_text: 尚侍想道：“夕雾右大臣年纪越大，相貌越是肖似父亲。

en.t: The Naishi no Kami thought, "The older the Right Minister Yugiri grows, the more his looks resemble his father's.

units.source_text: 这薰君的相貌却并不肖似父亲。

en.t: This Kaoru, however, does not resemble his father in appearance.

units.source_text: 但其姿态之安详、举止之优雅，则令人想起源氏主君盛年时代。

en.t: Yet the calm dignity of his bearing and the elegance of his manners call to mind Lord Genji in his prime.

units.source_text: 主君年轻时确是这样的。”

en.t: When our lord was young, he was truly just like this."
Thinking back on those days, she was overcome with emotion.

units.source_text: 薰君回去之后，香气还是弥漫室中，众侍女赞叹不已。

en.t: After Kaoru went away, the fragrance still filled the room, and the waiting women could not stop marveling at it.
